name: Log walls (cocoa beans)
description: Three-high jungle-log walls with cocoa on both faces; the player walks between two walls. SkyPilot reference layout derived from vanilla block-placement rules; it is not a copy of any community design. Check the Garden rules in-game before committing materials.
movement: Move to the next gap (+Z by 4)
harvest_direction: Along X; cocoa on both walls next to you
build_order: Cocoa can only be placed on the side of a jungle log: build the walls first.
